card.name: Linking words before political leader names
card.fires_on: Connecting words, commas, or titles such as "and", "&", "President" or "like" that come right before the next name of a famous political leader, in lists or pairs of heads of state.

modes.label: Lists of leaders
modes.description: The comma or "and" inside a run of president or leader names, just before the next name.
modes.example: Ford, Carter, Reagan, G.H.W. Bush, Clinton, G.W. Bush,<< and>> Obama.

modes.label: Title before a name
modes.description: The word President or a phrase like "leaders like" right before a leader's surname.
modes.example: while US<< President>> Barack Obama said America had lost a “

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the names of famous historical or political leaders, especially Chinese ones, and away from role words like examiner or supervisor.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the name of a president or national leader is expected.
